biggest_catch: Your friend must open a new SAFE checking account with a $25 minimum and make 25 or more debit card purchases within 60 days; only after both conditions are met do you and the friend each get $50. The referral card is filled out on paper and must be submitted when the friend opens the account.
catches: Friend must be a new SAFE Federal Credit Union member opening a new checking account with a $25 minimum opening balance (at any SAFE branch or online at www.safefed.org).
Friend must make 25 or more debit card purchases within 60 days of opening the account.
You fill out the paper BFF Referral Card and give it to your friend; the friend must submit it when opening the new account.
Bonus is $50 deposited into each of your accounts ($50 for you, $50 for the friend) once all activities are met.
Promotion details are from the official BFF Referral Program card; program can presumably be changed or ended.

steps: Fill out your information on the BFF Referral Card and tear it off for your friend.
Give the card to your friend and remind them to submit it when opening their new SAFE checking account.
Friend opens a new SAFE checking account with a $25 minimum (branch or online) and makes 25 or more debit card purchases within 60 days.
SAFE deposits $50 into your account (and $50 into the friend's account) once all requirements are met.
timing: $50 deposited to both accounts once all activities are met (no exact posting date stated).
when_cash_arrives: $50 deposited to both accounts once all activities are met (no exact posting date stated). Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
